name: Psilocybin mushrooms
addictionPotential: low abuse potential, no physical dependence potential
toxicity: extremely low toxicity relative to dose
summary: Psilocybin mushrooms is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Substituted tryptamines chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Psilocybin mushroom is a type of hallucinogenic mushroom and a polyphyletic informal group of fungi that contain the prodrug psilocybin, which is metabolised into the psychedelic compound psilocin following ingestion.

uses.text: Psilocybin-containing mushrooms may be used in whole form, for example consumption of dried or fresh mushrooms, or may be turned into extracts or food products such as mushroom edibles or mushroom tea. Psilocybin-containing mushrooms and products, as well as products containing related compounds like 4-AcO-DMT, may be purchased at smart shops like psychedelic mushroom stores in some jurisdictions.

summaryZh: 賽洛西賓蕈類即裸蓋菇，俗稱迷幻蘑菇、神奇魔菇、魔菇、牛屎菇，是含有裸蓋菇鹼和脫磷酸裸蓋菇素等迷幻物質的蕈類。它們在生物屬分類上涵蓋田頭菇屬、錐蓋傘屬、灰斑褶菇屬、盔孢傘屬、老傘屬、裸傘屬、韌傘屬、絲蓋傘屬、小菇屬、斑褶菇屬、光柄菇屬及裸蓋菇屬，總共約190種，其中又以裸蓋菇屬為大宗。
summaryZhHans: 赛洛西宾蕈类即裸盖菇，俗称迷幻蘑菇、神奇魔菇、魔菇、牛屎菇，是含有裸盖菇碱和脱磷酸裸盖菇素等迷幻物质的蕈类。它们在生物属分类上涵盖田头菇属、锥盖伞属、灰斑褶菇属、盔孢伞属、老伞属、裸伞属、韧伞属、丝盖伞属、小菇属、斑褶菇属、光柄菇属及裸盖菇属，总共约190种，其中又以裸盖菇属为大宗。
